name: The Venetian Resort (Venetian / Palazzo towers)
resort_fee_note: Official resort-fee page: 'Rates include a daily Resort Fee of $55 plus tax per night, payable upon check-in.' Includes Canyon Ranch fitness access for two, in-suite internet, boarding-pass printing, local calls, PressReader.
parking: Complimentary self-parking for non-registered hotel guests who play for three hours or more in tournaments or cash games (official player-parking page). The poker room has direct access to The Palazzo self-parking garage.
poker_rate: Reduced suite rates are offered to players who stay at The Venetian or The Palazzo and play poker with a Venetian Rewards card (official poker suite-rates page).
quality_note: AAA Five Diamond (Palazzo). On the same property as the Venetian poker room.

name: Resorts World Las Vegas (Hilton / Conrad / Crockfords)
resort_fee_text: $55 per room, per day (waived under the 'All Resort, No Fees' offer)
resort_fee_note: Official offer terms: 'The daily resort fee of $55 per room, will be waived for each night of your stay when booked under this offer. Standard room rate taxes still apply and are not waived. An additional incidental deposit of $150 per room will be required at check-in for each night of your stay.' Offer valid for travel through 28 December 2026; blackout dates may apply.
parking: Self-parking is complimentary for Nevada residents with NV plates and for Genting Rewards Elite, Prime, Monarch and Imperial tiers (official offer terms).
cancel: Reservations must be cancelled at least 48 hours before check-in for a refund of the deposit.
quality_note: Newest large resort on the north Strip. Poker room status: official site shows a poker-room section; no tournament schedule retrieved.
